title: e2e harness spawns bunkers before port check; serve worker leaks across runs

in_scope: Reorder e2e/global-setup.ts so assertPortFree(3100) runs before any bunker or serve spawn
Ensure a busy-port abort spawns zero children and writes no .state.json
Make the spawn/port-check/state-write region unit-testable via dependency injection
Regression test that fails under the old ordering and passes under the fix
out_of_scope: The serve spawn shape (direct-from-.bin + detached:true + process-group teardown) — already fixed in commits a334194 and 86dea56; left unchanged
cleanupOrphans() orphan sweep, the bunker.mjs PPID watchdog, and assertPortFree's no-kill policy — pre-existing and correct
The next build / make ensure-platform steps in globalSetup

constraints: assertPortFree must NOT kill discovered processes (feedback: never kill discovered processes; a past kill on port 3100 took down the VM)
Do not change e2e port to dodge conflicts
Build must remain green under npx tsc --noEmit / make build (vitest passing alone does not prove the typecheck)
Tests must be relay-state-independent — the reproduction injects fakes and starts no real process or relay
non_goals: Changing how readiness (HTTP health check) is detected
Touching unrelated bunker key rotation logic
